sources.quote: The restatement recognized a $91.7 million loss, cut cash by $93.6 million, and swung the net-worth ratio from positive 9% to negative 107%.
sources.searcher_note: Same entity, same Q1 restatement: $91.7M loss, net worth ratio to -107%; also says the share insurance fund 'will likely absorb $77 million or more'. Page shows 'June 16' without a year; context is 2026. Does not state the deposits-to-assets ratio.

sources.searcher_note: Earliest found on the Q1 2026 $91.7M loss (headline only; page returned 403). Search summary said the loss moved industry ROA by over one basis point.

sources.quote: The credit union also posted a year-to-date net loss of $103 million, compared with $1.23 million in net income for all of 2025
sources.searcher_note: Recent (post-2026-06-30), later window: June 30 call report, net worth -$88.5M, ratio -145.4%, assets down from $162.4M to $60.9M, YTD loss $103M. No Q1 or deposits-vs-assets figures.

sources.quote: NCUA placed Jackson Area Federal Credit Union into conservatorship because of unsafe and unsound practices at the credit union.
sources.searcher_note: Primary record: conservatorship on 2026-05-06; release cites $162,360,956 assets (pre-restatement) and 15,561 members.

sources.quote: Jackson Area FCU made $1.2-million in net income in 2025 and $135,527 through March, according to Call Report data.
sources.searcher_note: Disagrees on Q1 as first filed: original March 2026 call report showed a profit and 9.51% net worth, before the restatement that recorded the $91.7M loss.
Not a story: a page re-publishing the March 31, 2026 call report. Shares & deposits $148,178,414; total assets $71,355,580; undivided earnings -$77,024,237; net income -$91,737,477; 15,704 members.

notes: Heavily covered in credit-union trade press and by NCUA. The $91.7M Q1 loss and the net worth ratio going to about -107% are published (CU Times headline 2026-06-04; Treichel 2026-06-16). No story found stating that deposits are 2.08x assets, or that Jackson Area is the only one of ~4,250 credit unions over 2x (median 0.86x); those numbers appear only as raw call report fields on a data-mirror page. Related: NCUA alleges about $95M diverted (civil suit filed ~2026-05-15; CU Times 2026-06-10, CU Today 2026-06-11); criminal bill of information expected (CU Today 2026-08-12; WLBT 2026-09-17, recent local coverage, not recorded because its entity-naming sentence names private individuals not in the lead). Treichel 2026-05 'Five Lessons' post: year-end 2025 net worth 9.2%, ~66% of assets as cash at other institutions. CU Times 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-31 returned 403. Visbanking page showed no data.
